Payload buffers and query-tree destruction are inside run_q2_census total; common owner/index/plan destruction belongs to each arm total.
read_only_review.timing_scope: generation+fixture hash+owner+global index+prefilter+one consumption+common destruction; paired inspection separate; CLI/JSON serialization and capture excluded explicitly
read_only_review.capture_validation: strict parse, tuple checks, raw stdout/base64 retained, binary per invocation and source/binary final pins; exact matrix and homogeneous recorded provenance for every discovered manifest
read_only_review.limitation: parent discovery enumerates only */MANIFEST.json, so a real COMPLETION-only failed child is omitted

recommendation: Discover directories carrying any MANIFEST.json, COMPLETION.json, or MEASURES.jsonl; reject incomplete campaign triplets in the checked group, or explicitly report excluded failures without an unqualified complete/pass claim. Test one positive sibling plus one genuine missing-binary initialization failure under normal and -O.
not_qualified: source-to-binary rebuild or hostile artifact authentication
WSPD generation, canonical ball deduplication, q3/q4 or FULL pipeline
timing speedup or isolated host performance
